text:
maya: Quick decision needed for observability v1: do we ship 'Allocation-Gated Billing' (accurate but slower) or 'Route-First Dashboards' (fast to value, coarser billing)? Need launch criteria and rollout plan today.

chris: Customer asks split two ways: finance wants per-tenant invoice-ready numbers; SREs want quick per-route visibility and trace links. Our choice impacts infra and UI scope.

jin: Technical reality: exact tenant attribution requires tracking model-level shared costs + cache allocation. That's extra compute and nightly recalcs. Route-first gives immediate insight with much less infra impact.

harper: Suggest a hybrid landing: Route-first dashboards + a separate "allocated billing" export labeled as ESTIMATED. Acceptance: exported CSV must include allocation method and uncertainty %.

maya: Concrete launch criteria if we go hybrid:
- Dashboard: per-route cost table (top 30), error rate column, link to sampled trace id if available
- Billing export: estimated per-tenant CSV with allocation method field and uncertainty <= 20% for 80% of tenants
- Tracing: global sample <=0.25%, error=100%
- Perf: p95 latency delta <4% in canary
- Infra cost projection: delta <=15% for beta cohort

chris: Runtime hooks required: tag requests with tenant_id, route, model.hash; emit invocation.weight and cache_hit boolean. We'll need a toggle to flip allocation from 'proportional' to 'direct' in case of disputes.

jin: Sampling config proposal:
```
trace.global_sampling=0.0025 # 0.25%
trace.error_sampling=1.0
allocation.method=proportional_by_invocations
```
This keeps trace volume low and guarantees error coverage.

ops: Bench summary (staging): with 0.25% sampling at 50k rps -> ~40GB/day traces, p95 +2.8%. With 0.1% -> ~16GB/day, p95 +1.2%. Storage/latency tradeoff is real.

harper: UI deliverables for v1: route table, CSV export modal with allocation metadata, an uncertainty badge, and a trace-link column (opens trace viewer or shows "no sample"). Two templates: Billing and Ops.

maya: Rollout plan: internal canary 3% for 7 days -> monitor p95, infra delta, allocation accuracy on synthetic ground-truth -> expand to 25% for 14 days -> GA. Need comms to finance and SRE beta customers.

chris: Engineering asks: 2 backend (allocation + export), 1 infra for benching, 1 frontend for templates. Estimate 3 sprints to deliver canary. Also request a small synthetic harness to validate allocation heuristics.

qa-bot: Test checklist added: export CSV schema, allocation uncertainty simulation cases, trace-link open/404 behavior, toggle rollback works. Ticket: https://tracker/redwood/PRD-711

maya: If no objections I'll lock the hybrid route-first + estimated billing plan at EOD and attach the acceptance criteria to the roadmap. Please speak up if you want pure allocation-first instead. :lock:
